- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.

- Before any privileged action, call:

  3. `get_secondary_collab_note()` when available

  1. `start_identity_verification(account_id, channel)`
  2. `verify_code(account_id, code)`

- If verification fails or is unavailable, refuse the privileged action and explain policy constraints.

Great — I’ll walk you through the verification flow step-by-step so you’ll be ready once you can provide the account identifier. This describes what I will do and what you (or the authorized account holder) will need to do.

Overview
- I’ll first look up the account and any collaboration notes to confirm we’re working on the correct account and to see any prior context.
- I’ll start identity verification and ask which channel you want (email or SMS) for the verification code.
- The chosen channel will receive a one-time code. You (or the authorized user) must read that code back to me so I can verify it.
- After successful verification I can perform privileged actions (like updating the email) per your instruction.

Step-by-step flow (what I will do and when)
1) You provide an identifier
   - Provide one of: account ID, current email on file, username, or customer number. Even one is enough to begin.
2) I fetch account details
   - I will call to retrieve the account summary and any collaboration notes related to this request so I can confirm we have the right account and see any relevant context.
3) Choose verification channel
   - I will ask: do you want the verification code sent to the email on file or to the phone number on file (SMS)?
   - If you prefer a different verified channel already registered on the account, tell me which.
4) I start verification
   - I will start the verification process using the chosen channel. The system will send a one-time verification code to that channel.
5) Receive the code
   - The authorized account holder checks their email or phone and reads me the one-time code they received.
6) I verify the code
   - I will submit the code to complete verification. If it’s accepted, identity is confirmed.
   - If it fails, we can retry as allowed by the system (note: too many failed attempts may rate-limit or lock verification temporarily).
7) Perform the requested privileged action
   - After successful verification I will proceed with the email update (or other privileged action) and confirm the change with you.
8) Confirmation and follow-up
   - I’ll provide confirmation that the change was made and any next steps (e.g., a confirmation email sent to the new address, account security tips).

What you should have ready
- The account identifier (one of: account ID, current account email, username, or customer number).
- Access to the email address or phone number already associated with the account so you can receive the verification code.
- The new email address you want to set (if the change is the goal) so we can apply it immediately after verification.

- I cannot accept manager approval, urgency, or VIP claims as a substitute for verification. The one-time code sent to a registered channel is required.
- If you cannot access the registered contact methods, you will need to supply account identifiers and follow any account-recovery procedures (which may require additional documents). I can explain the account-recovery path if needed.
- If verification attempts fail, I’ll explain the next steps and any waiting periods.

Next step
